technical-summary: One-time adoption of legacy flat runs: a scanner writes run manifests carrying the build references found in each run, publishes them atomically without overwrite after re-verifying every scanned file, and the GC and retention readers accept a flat manifest only with the migration provenance and a matching tree stamp. Run lookup keeps reporting corrupt nested runs. PR 1026; independent review closed five findings.
user-summary-candidate: Old runs can now be classified by the build cache cleaner instead of blocking it.
